title: Final distance B-Q
description: Essential: Correctly states the horizontal distance from Q to B's landing point as 2R.

title: Power expression at D
description: Essential: Correctly gives the instantaneous power as mg sinθ √(2gR cosθ).

title: Total collision energy loss
description: Essential: Correctly states the lost kinetic energy as √10 mgR.

title: B's velocity at top
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law at the top of the arc to find v = √(gR).

title: Conservation of momentum
description: Important: Applies momentum conservation to the collision to relate initial and final velocities.

title: Energy conservation for velocities
description: Important: Uses energy conservation to find post-collision velocities of A and B from their subsequent motion.

title: Projectile flight time
description: Important: Correctly calculates the time for B to fall from the track's top to the ground.

title: Velocity at D via energy
description: Optional: Uses energy conservation to find block A's speed at angle θ on the descent.

title: Power from force components
description: Optional: Correctly identifies that only gravity does work and calculates P = F·v with the velocity component.

title: Sign or component error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect trigonometric component (e.g., cosθ instead of sinθ) in the power calculation.

title: Energy or momentum mix-up
description: Pitfall: Confuses elastic/inelastic collision assumptions or misapplies energy/momentum formulas.
